stage_a.ice_rule: surface minus bedrock > 10 m on more than 50% of the window

method.score: percentile of Earth's valid land windows that are less similar (100 = most similar on Earth)
method.stability: share of 200 random weight sets (Dirichlet alpha=4.0) in which the window stays in Earth's top 0.1%; rank_median / rank_worst = its rank on Earth across those draws
method.ranking: candidates are pre-selected by the 1 km screen and ordered by the 500 m confirmation distance (rank = confirm_rank)
method.dataset_agreement_caveat: ETOPO 2022 land heights are largely derived from Copernicus DEM, so the agreement test checks processing consistency across products and resolutions, not fully independent measurements

verdicts.z: difference of log features divided by Earth's natural variability

geology.earth: Macrostrat map unit at the window centre, classified by keyword into rock classes
geology.targets: rock classes from published papers (see each target's citation)

verdicts.holds: shares the target's primary rock class

method.novelty: distance to the nearest of GeoProxy's 14 established analog sites; < 50 km = established
